newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Moscow chooses lead-managers for debut bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Moscow chooses lead-managers for debut bond issue.

text.p: The City of Moscow said it had selected CS First Boston and Nomura International as joint lead managers for its debut offering of international bonds.
The city authority's press centre said the lead managers would be assisted by Russia's Alfa-Bank and Stolichny Bank Sberezhenii.
City officials have said Moscow plans to issue foreign-currency bonds, probably for $300 million, on international markets.
It would be the first such issue by the city since before the 1917 Bolshevik Revolution.
Other details have not yet been finalised.
